nodes.text: Recent studies show that human metapneumovirus (HMPV), often mistaken for the flu, has also surged among young patients. "We’re seeing a perfect storm of respiratory illnesses this season," says Dr. Lin Wei, a pediatrician at a Beijing hospital.

nodes.author: iam0marR_
nodes.text: Meanwhile, avian flu strains like H9N2 and the rarely seen H10N5 have raised alarms. In Fujian province, the deadly H5N6 virus claimed two lives this year, underscoring the persistent threat of zoonotic diseases.

nodes.author: iam0marR_
nodes.text: Health officials have ramped up vaccination campaigns and encouraged citizens to adopt preventive measures such as wearing masks and avoiding crowded areas. Yet, public health experts warn that heightened vigilance is needed,

nodes.author: iam0marR_
nodes.text:
particularly in rural areas where contact with poultry is common.

For China, the flu season is more than just a yearly battle—it’s a reminder of the delicate balance between human health and the natural world.
